calibration_types.quick1PositionLevelCalibrationPlace: Quick 1-position level calibration. Place your vehicle on a flat surface.
calibration_types.onePositionVehicleLevelAndStill: One position, vehicle level and still. Writes the offsets ArduPilot wants before it will arm, without turning the vehicle over.
calibration_types.rotateYourVehicleInAllDirections: Rotate your vehicle in all directions to calibrate the compass.
calibration_types.quickGyroCalibrationKeepYourVehicle: Quick gyro calibration. Keep your vehicle completely still.
calibration_types.calibrateOpticalFlowSensorInavOnly: Calibrate optical flow sensor. iNav only.

prearm_checks.theFrameLayoutIsNotSet: The frame layout is not set for this vehicle. Set the frame class and type to match how the motors are arranged.
prearm_checks.throttleIsNotAtMinimumPull: Throttle is not at minimum. Pull the throttle stick fully down, and check its trim on the transmitter.
prearm_checks.theCompassHasNotBeenCalibrated: The compass has not been calibrated, or its calibration no longer fits.
prearm_checks.theCompassReadingsDisagreeOrThe: The compass readings disagree or the magnetic field looks wrong. Move away from metal and power cables, check each compass orientation, then recalibrate.
prearm_checks.aCompassIsNotRespondingCheck: A compass is not responding. Check its wiring and that it is detected.
prearm_checks.theGyrosDisagreeOrAreNot: The gyros disagree or are not calibrated. Keep the vehicle completely still and reboot, or run a gyro calibration.
prearm_checks.theBarometerIsNotRespondingCheck: The barometer is not responding. Check the flight controller hardware and reboot.
prearm_checks.theAirspeedSensorIsNotResponding: The airspeed sensor is not responding. Check its wiring and the pitot tube.
prearm_checks.theAttitudeEstimateIsNotReady: The attitude estimate is not ready. Keep the vehicle still and give it a minute, or fix the sensor errors shown above.
prearm_checks.theRangefinderIsNotRespondingCheck: The rangefinder is not responding. Check its wiring. If none is fitted, its type must be set to none.
prearm_checks.theEkfCannotConvergeKeepThe: The EKF cannot converge. Keep the vehicle still. In SITL, restart with "Wipe EEPROM" and wait 60-90 s after boot.
prearm_checks.theImuCoresDisagreeUsuallyStale: The IMU cores disagree, usually stale calibration. Recalibrate the accelerometers. In SITL, restart with "Wipe EEPROM".
prearm_checks.theEkfNeedsAValidPosition: The EKF needs a valid position. Wait for a GPS lock and 60-90 s after boot for it to converge.
prearm_checks.theEkfNeedsAnAltitudeEstimate: The EKF needs an altitude estimate. This follows from other sensor errors, fix those first.
prearm_checks.theFlightControllerAsksYouTo: The flight controller asks you to wait for the sensors to settle, or to reboot it.
prearm_checks.waitingForAGps3dFix: Waiting for a GPS 3D fix. Move to open sky and wait.
prearm_checks.theGpsHasNoUsableFix: The GPS has no usable fix yet, or is not detected. Wait under open sky; if it persists, check the GPS setup.
prearm_checks.theRadioChannelsHaveNotBeen: The radio channels have not been calibrated.
prearm_checks.theFlightControllerIsInRadio: The flight controller is in radio failsafe. Switch the transmitter on and check it is bound, and that its throttle range sits above the failsafe value.
prearm_checks.theBatteryIsLowOrNot: The battery is low or not reported correctly. Charge or replace it, and check the battery monitor if the reading looks wrong.
prearm_checks.loggingIsNotAvailableTheSd: Logging is not available: the SD card is missing, full or failed. Insert or replace the card.
prearm_checks.pressAndHoldTheSafetySwitch: Press and hold the safety switch on the vehicle until its light goes solid.
prearm_checks.theConfiguredBoardTypeDoesNot: The configured board type does not match this flight controller.
prearm_checks.theFenceNeedsAPositionOr: The fence needs a position, or the vehicle is outside it. Wait for a GPS lock, or move the vehicle inside the fence.
prearm_checks.theMissionCannotStartAsIt: The mission cannot start as it is. Check it in the mission planner.
prearm_checks.noAutomaticFixIsKnownFor: No automatic fix is known for this check. The message comes straight from the flight controller; the pre-arm reference explains each one.
prearm_checks.thePositionEstimateIsNotReady: The position estimate is not ready. Wait for a GPS lock under open sky and for the estimator to settle.
prearm_checks.waitingForAGpsFixMove: Waiting for a GPS fix. Move to open sky and wait; if it persists, check the GPS setup.
prearm_checks.theMagnetometerIsNotCalibratedOr: The magnetometer is not calibrated, or its readings disagree. Move away from metal and power cables and recalibrate.
prearm_checks.theAccelerometerIsNotCalibratedOr: The accelerometer is not calibrated or inconsistent.
prearm_checks.theGyroscopeIsNotCalibratedKeep: The gyroscope is not calibrated. Keep the vehicle completely still during calibration.
prearm_checks.highVibrationOrAccelerometerClippingImpr: High vibration or accelerometer clipping. Improve the flight controller mounting and isolation, and balance the props.
prearm_checks.theAttitudeEstimateIsNotStable: The attitude estimate is not stable. Level the vehicle, reduce vibration and let the estimator settle.
prearm_checks.theRadioIsNotCalibratedOr: The radio is not calibrated or its signal is lost. Switch the transmitter on, check it is bound, and calibrate it.
prearm_checks.theBatteryIsLowOrUnhealthy: The battery is low or unhealthy. Charge or replace it, and check the battery setup if the reading looks wrong.
prearm_checks.anEscOrMotorProblemWas: An ESC or motor problem was detected. Check the ESC wiring, telemetry and motor outputs.
prearm_checks.aGeofenceConditionIsBlockingArming: A geofence condition is blocking arming. Move the vehicle inside the fence, or review the fence.
prearm_checks.theHomePositionIsNotSet: The home position is not set yet. Wait for a valid position so home can be captured.
prearm_checks.theKillSwitchIsEngagedDisengage: The kill switch is engaged. Disengage it on the transmitter before arming.
prearm_checks.noAutomaticFixIsKnownFor2: No automatic fix is known for this check. The message comes straight from the flight controller; the preflight check reference explains each one.

safety_config_checks.ifTheAircraftLosesTrackOf: If the aircraft loses track of where it is, nothing will happen
safety_config_checks.theNavigationQualityCheckIsSwitched: The navigation quality check is switched off
safety_config_checks.onAFenceBreachTheAircraft: On a fence breach the aircraft will try to fly home
safety_config_checks.theCompassCalibrationIsWeakerThan: The compass calibration is weaker than it should be
safety_config_checks.aFlatBatteryWillOnlyProduce: A flat battery will only produce a warning
safety_config_checks.returnWhenCriticalLandWhenEmpty: Return when critical, land when empty
safety_config_checks.losingTheGroundStationLinkDoes: Losing the ground station link does nothing
safety_config_checks.holdPositionInsteadOfFlyingHome: Hold position instead of flying home
safety_config_checks.losingTheRadioWillCutThe: Losing the radio will cut the motors
safety_config_checks.theCompassStrengthCheckIsSwitched: The compass strength check is switched off
safety_config_checks.refuseToArmOnABad: Refuse to arm on a bad compass

calibration_quality.noFitnessReportedByTheFlight: No fitness reported by the flight controller.
calibration_quality.calibrationValuesNotReadFromThe: Calibration values not read from the vehicle.
calibration_quality.factoryDefaultsThisAccelerometerHasNever: Factory defaults: this accelerometer has never been calibrated.
calibration_quality.couldNotReadTheCalibrationBack: Could not read the calibration back from the vehicle.
calibration_quality.calibrationConfirmedOnTheVehicleAfter: Calibration confirmed on the vehicle after reboot.
